name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | HubSpot, Retention & AI-Driven Workflow Improvement
summary: Customer success professional with 15+ years owning account portfolios in SaaS environments, from onboarding through renewal. Manages customer health, communication, and retention in HubSpot, flags at-risk accounts before they churn, and brings genuine hands-on experience using AI tools to improve day-to-day workflows, not just talking about them. Comfortable working independently in a remote, small-team environment, inheriting an existing book of business and keeping it healthy.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary client relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and account management to keep records and service updates current.
Architect and deploy AI-driven agent systems and automation workflows, identifying opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy across client operations.
Architect and manage CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and data-hygiene protocols, documenting every client interaction and deliverable.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder client accounts in HubSpot, translating performance data into strategic recommendations and resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partner accounts, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, analyzing utilization and performance data to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration, equipping them to communicate product value to their own end customers.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets, while maintaining accurate CRM records for a high-value account portfolio.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
